tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The table: the screen ground under everything. Flat, never a gradient or grain. text-1, text-2, accent-text, positive and negative are checked on it in both themes; text-3 only for meta and large text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Calm chrome on canvas: grouped settings lists, filled text fields, secondary buttons, merchant monograms, cards that are not accounts. Pair with the shadow-surface edge. text-1, text-2, accent-text, positive and negative are checked on it.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Ground of sheets and the AmountField panel; one step closer than surface in dark mode. text-1, text-2, accent-text, positive and negative are checked on it.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Groups and fields that sit inside a sheet (on surface-2). text-1 and text-2 are checked on it; text-3 only for large text and glyphs.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: The one raised thumb language: the selected tab, the segmented-control thumb. Always with shadow-knob. text-1 reads on it (8.2:1 dark, 17.9:1 light).

tokens.name: fill-subtle
tokens.usage: Soft fills on surface: segmented track, chip and quick-add pills, pressed rows, the soft button, settings glyph tiles. text-1 and text-2 are checked on it composited over surface.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Toggle off track, skeleton blocks, the bars of a spend chart. Not a text ground.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline (0.5px) between rows, inset to the text start; the collapsed navigation bar edge. Decorative, never the only cue.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating chrome only (tab bar, bar buttons over content) with blur 24px saturate 180% and shadow-glass. Never content, never glass on glass. With Reduce Transparency use surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind a sheet or alert.

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Titles, body, amounts. Checked on canvas, surface, surface-2, surface-3, thumb, fill-subtle, accent-soft, positive-soft and negative-soft in both themes (12:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Subtitles, metadata, field labels, settings headers, the currency symbol beside a large amount, unselected tab glyphs. 4.5:1 or more on canvas, surface, surface-2, surface-3 and fill-subtle in both themes.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Meta and large only: chevrons, placeholders, the sheet grabber, disabled labels, text 24px and larger that should recede. 3:1 or more on canvas, surface, surface-2 and surface-3; never for body-size information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Marigold fill: the one prominent button per screen, the toggle on track, the Tap-to-pay ripple, the AmountField caret. Text on it is on-accent, never white.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of an accent fill. on-accent stays 10:1 or more on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Ink label and icon on accent and accent-pressed in both themes (11.1:1 on accent).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Marigold as text: links such as "Xem tất cả", the selected check, the active step. 5:1 or more on canvas, surface, surface-2 and accent-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted marigold ground for a "new" badge or the selected quick-add chip, with text-1 or accent-text on top.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ring drawn outside a 2px gap filled with canvas, so the ring always sits against canvas colour, even beside a coloured object. Ink, not marigold: 11:1 or more on canvas, surface, surface-2 and surface-3 in both themes.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Inflows (+ amounts) and confirmations, as text or icon. Always with a sign or word. 4.5:1 or more on canvas, surface, surface-2, surface-3 and positive-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Delta chip and "arrived" row flash, with positive or text-1 on top.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Errors, failed payments, over-limit and destructive labels. Not for ordinary spending: outflows stay text-1. 4.5:1 or more on canvas, surface, surface-2, surface-3 and negative-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill and error banners, with negative on top.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Toggle knob on accent or fill-strong, always with shadow-knob.

tokens.name: on-object
tokens.usage: Primary ink on the five light object fields (marigold, tomato, sky, mint, lilac) and their end stops: 5.6:1 on the tomato end stop, 9:1 or more on the rest. Balance, account name, chip glyph.

tokens.name: on-graphite
tokens.usage: Primary ink on obj-graphite and obj-graphite-end in both themes (10:1 or more; 6:1 or more under the graphite specular, which runs at a third of opacity-specular).

tokens.name: obj-marigold
tokens.usage: Marigold. The default first account (everyday spending). The same hue as accent, so a marigold card is the most "Pebble" object. Account and card faces only; never chrome, never a text colour. Ink: on-object.

tokens.name: obj-marigold-end
tokens.usage: Gradient end stop of obj-marigold (6% darker), lit from the top left: linear-gradient(155deg, obj-marigold, obj-marigold-end). on-object is checked on both stops.

tokens.name: obj-tomato
tokens.usage: Tomato. Warm, loud: give it to a card people spend from often, or to a shared account. Account and card faces only; never chrome, never a text colour. Ink: on-object.

tokens.name: obj-tomato-end
tokens.usage: Gradient end stop of obj-tomato (6% darker), lit from the top left: linear-gradient(155deg, obj-tomato, obj-tomato-end). on-object is checked on both stops.

tokens.name: obj-sky
tokens.usage: Sky. Calm: travel funds, foreign-currency or salary accounts. Account and card faces only; never chrome, never a text colour. Ink: on-object.

tokens.name: obj-sky-end
tokens.usage: Gradient end stop of obj-sky (6% darker), lit from the top left: linear-gradient(155deg, obj-sky, obj-sky-end). on-object is checked on both stops.

tokens.name: obj-mint
tokens.usage: Mint. Savings and goals. Account and card faces only; never chrome, never a text colour. Ink: on-object.

tokens.name: obj-mint-end
tokens.usage: Gradient end stop of obj-mint (6% darker), lit from the top left: linear-gradient(155deg, obj-mint, obj-mint-end). on-object is checked on both stops.

tokens.name: obj-lilac
tokens.usage: Lilac. Bills, subscriptions, a partner or family account. Account and card faces only; never chrome, never a text colour. Ink: on-object.

tokens.name: obj-lilac-end
tokens.usage: Gradient end stop of obj-lilac (6% darker), lit from the top left: linear-gradient(155deg, obj-lilac, obj-lilac-end). on-object is checked on both stops.

tokens.name: obj-graphite
tokens.usage: Graphite. The quiet object: a credit card or a business account. Lifted in dark mode so it does not sink into canvas. Account and card faces only; never chrome, never a text colour. Ink: on-graphite.

tokens.name: obj-graphite-end
tokens.usage: Gradient end stop of obj-graphite (6% darker), lit from the top left: linear-gradient(155deg, obj-graphite, obj-graphite-end). on-graphite is checked on both stops.

tokens.name: tint-marigold
tokens.usage: Pastel marigold field behind a 3D emoji in a category tile (row tile 40, grid tile 60) and behind empty-state and success moments. Holds pictures only, never text; give it the shadow-surface edge on canvas. In dark mode it is obj-marigold at 22% over surface so the emoji does not glare.

tokens.name: tint-tomato
tokens.usage: Pastel tomato field behind a 3D emoji in a category tile (row tile 40, grid tile 60) and behind empty-state and success moments. Holds pictures only, never text; give it the shadow-surface edge on canvas. In dark mode it is obj-tomato at 22% over surface so the emoji does not glare.

tokens.name: tint-sky
tokens.usage: Pastel sky field behind a 3D emoji in a category tile (row tile 40, grid tile 60) and behind empty-state and success moments. Holds pictures only, never text; give it the shadow-surface edge on canvas. In dark mode it is obj-sky at 22% over surface so the emoji does not glare.

tokens.name: tint-mint
tokens.usage: Pastel mint field behind a 3D emoji in a category tile (row tile 40, grid tile 60) and behind empty-state and success moments. Holds pictures only, never text; give it the shadow-surface edge on canvas. In dark mode it is obj-mint at 22% over surface so the emoji does not glare.

tokens.name: tint-lilac
tokens.usage: Pastel lilac field behind a 3D emoji in a category tile (row tile 40, grid tile 60) and behind empty-state and success moments. Holds pictures only, never text; give it the shadow-surface edge on canvas. In dark mode it is obj-lilac at 22% over surface so the emoji does not glare.

tokens.name: on-obj-marigold
tokens.usage: Primary ink on obj-marigold (alias of on-object).

tokens.name: on-obj-marigold-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink on obj-marigold: account name, "•• 4821", the ₫ beside the card balance. 4.5:1 or more on both gradient stops in both themes.

tokens.name: on-obj-tomato
tokens.usage: Primary ink on obj-tomato (alias of on-object).

tokens.name: on-obj-tomato-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink on obj-tomato: account name, "•• 4821", the ₫ beside the card balance. 4.5:1 or more on both gradient stops in both themes.

tokens.name: on-obj-sky
tokens.usage: Primary ink on obj-sky (alias of on-object).

tokens.name: on-obj-sky-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink on obj-sky: account name, "•• 4821", the ₫ beside the card balance. 4.5:1 or more on both gradient stops in both themes.

tokens.name: on-obj-mint
tokens.usage: Primary ink on obj-mint (alias of on-object).

tokens.name: on-obj-mint-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink on obj-mint: account name, "•• 4821", the ₫ beside the card balance. 4.5:1 or more on both gradient stops in both themes.

tokens.name: on-obj-lilac
tokens.usage: Primary ink on obj-lilac (alias of on-object).

tokens.name: on-obj-lilac-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink on obj-lilac: account name, "•• 4821", the ₫ beside the card balance. 4.5:1 or more on both gradient stops in both themes.

tokens.name: on-obj-graphite
tokens.usage: Primary ink on obj-graphite (alias of on-graphite).

tokens.name: on-obj-graphite-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink on obj-graphite: account name, "•• 4821", the ₫ beside the card balance. 4.5:1 or more on both gradient stops and under the specular highlight in both themes.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
families.rounded: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The one hero number on a screen: total balance on Home, the amount on a receipt. Bricolage at wdth 88, tabular figures (tnum) on. ₫ at 0.5em, weight 500, text-2, raised.

styles.name: display-entry
styles.usage: AmountField while typing. tnum on so digits do not jump.

styles.name: title-screen
styles.usage: Root-screen title (replaces the iOS large title) on Cards, Activity, Profile. Home has no title: the balance is the title.

styles.name: display-card
styles.usage: Balance on an AccountCard, recipient amount in a sheet. tnum on.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Content section headers on money screens, with a trailing accent-text link. Settings and forms keep label.

styles.name: amount-row
styles.usage: Trailing amount in a content row and inline amounts. tnum on; ₫ at 0.72em on the baseline in text-2.

styles.name: monogram
styles.usage: Initials inside a 40px merchant or person monogram.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Inline navigation title, sheet title, recipient name, emphasised row titles. On Android (Inter) use -0.2px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Thẻ đã được khoá tạm thời.
styles.usage: Default text and settings row titles. Android: -0.2px.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Labels of md and lg buttons. Never wraps.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Title of a content row (transactions, people). Android: -0.15px.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Field input text and short supporting copy.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Greeting, secondary lines in sheets. Android: -0.1px.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Small buttons and section links.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Row subtitles, helper and error text, settings section footers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows above amounts, field labels, settings section headers, account names on cards. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and fine print. The smallest size allowed.

styles.name: tile-label
styles.usage: Label under a 60px quick-action or category tile, in text-1.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: Label beside the Fill glyph inside the selected marigold tab pill, in on-accent. Unselected tabs show the glyph only and carry the label as their accessible name.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Quick-add chips and delta chips (SF Pro Rounded on iOS). tnum on.

spacing.note: 4pt base. Lay siblings out with gaps. Home rhythm: header to hero 20, eyebrow to amount 4, amount to chip 10, chip to card stack 24, stack to actions 20, actions to section 32, section header to rows 8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; eyebrow to amount.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; section header to its rows; inset of a sheet from the display edge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Leading monogram to text; vertical padding of a content row; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding inside a group; padding inside sheets and the AmountField panel.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; header to hero; stack to actions.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero to card stack; between list sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Actions to the next content section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Breathing room above an empty state or a success amount.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on phones 390pt and wider (16px below). Cards and groups sit on the gutter; text inside them is inset again.

radius.note: Continuous (superellipse) corners everywhere. Nested shapes are concentric: inner radius = outer radius minus the inset.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges and the mini card chip inside a row.

tokens.name: radius-glyph
tokens.usage: 30px settings glyph tiles only.

tokens.name: radius-tile-sm
tokens.usage: 44px icon tile (tile-sm) and the 40px emoji row tile: about a third of the side, superellipse.

tokens.name: radius-tile-lg
tokens.usage: 60px quick-action and category grid tile (tile-lg).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Tiles: filled text fields, quick-action tiles, the AmountField panel, groups inside a sheet (concentric with radius-sheet at a 16px inset).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Account cards and every card or grouped list on canvas.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a sheet.

tokens.name: radius-sheet-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom corners of a sheet floating 8px inside the display (55px display corner minus the 8px inset).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: buttons, chips, toggles, segmented controls, the tab bar, monograms.

shadow.note: Objects cast shadows; chrome gets a hairline edge. One light source, top left: highlights on top edges, shadows fall down and slightly right.

tokens.name: shadow-surface
tokens.usage: Edge of calm chrome (surface groups, fields, secondary buttons, monograms). A hairline, not a lift: chrome does not cast shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-highlight
tokens.usage: 1px top inner highlight: the lit lip of every coloured object (account cards, the prominent button). Light comes from the top left.

tokens.name: shadow-obj-marigold
tokens.usage: Two-layer resting shadow of an obj-marigold object: a contact layer and a soft key layer, tinted with the object hue in light mode, neutral in dark. Combine with shadow-highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-obj-tomato
tokens.usage: Two-layer resting shadow of an obj-tomato object: a contact layer and a soft key layer, tinted with the object hue in light mode, neutral in dark. Combine with shadow-highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-obj-sky
tokens.usage: Two-layer resting shadow of an obj-sky object: a contact layer and a soft key layer, tinted with the object hue in light mode, neutral in dark. Combine with shadow-highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-obj-mint
tokens.usage: Two-layer resting shadow of an obj-mint object: a contact layer and a soft key layer, tinted with the object hue in light mode, neutral in dark. Combine with shadow-highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-obj-lilac
tokens.usage: Two-layer resting shadow of an obj-lilac object: a contact layer and a soft key layer, tinted with the object hue in light mode, neutral in dark. Combine with shadow-highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-obj-graphite
tokens.usage: Two-layer resting shadow of an obj-graphite object: a contact layer and a soft key layer, tinted with the object hue in light mode, neutral in dark. Combine with shadow-highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-obj-press
tokens.usage: Pressed or dipped object: the shadow tightens as the object nears the table. Used on press (scale 0.96) and at the bottom of the Tap-to-pay dip.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: The prominent marigold button: a small object in the chrome, lit like the cards.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Floating glass: the tab bar capsule and bar buttons over content.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The raised thumb: toggle knob, segmented thumb, selected tab.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and alerts above the scrim.

tokens.name: hit-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable size, even when the visible shape is smaller.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and compact segmented controls (hit area padded to 44).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Regular buttons and the segmented control.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The bottom call to action and Home action row.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Filled text field.

tokens.name: row-content
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a content row (40px monogram, two lines).

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a settings row.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Merchant and person monograms in rows; the Home header avatar.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Recipient monogram in a sheet.

tokens.name: glyph-tile
tokens.usage: Settings glyph tile.

tokens.name: icon-size-inline
tokens.usage: Phosphor Bold inside buttons, chips, chevrons and inline with text (renders about 1.5px stroke).

tokens.name: icon-size-nav
tokens.usage: Phosphor Regular in bar buttons, settings glyph tiles and rows (about 1.5px stroke).

tokens.name: icon-size-tab
tokens.usage: Tab bar: Phosphor Regular in ink; the selected tab swaps to Fill in ink inside the marigold pill.

tokens.name: tab-pill
tokens.usage: Height of the marigold selected-tab pill (radius-full) holding the Fill glyph and its label.

tokens.name: tile-row
tokens.usage: Category tile leading a transaction row: tint-* field, radius-tile-sm, a 24px 3D emoji (emoji-row).

tokens.name: tile-sm
tokens.usage: Small icon tile in lists: obj-* field, radius-tile-sm, 22px Phosphor Duotone glyph in on-object ink.

tokens.name: tile-lg
tokens.usage: Quick-action and category grid tile: radius-tile-lg; a 28px Duotone glyph in ink on an obj-* field, or a 36px 3D emoji (emoji-tile) on a tint-* field.

tokens.name: emoji-row
tokens.usage: 3D emoji inside a 40px row tile. At most one per row.

tokens.name: emoji-tile
tokens.usage: 3D emoji inside a 60px grid tile (0.6 of the tile; the art has built-in padding).

tokens.name: emoji-moment
tokens.usage: Empty states and success or goal moments, 96 to 128px, entering on spring.pebble. Never in bars, buttons, inputs or amounts.

tokens.name: emoji-onboarding
tokens.usage: Onboarding illustrations only.

tokens.name: card-aspect
tokens.usage: Account card width to height (ISO ID-1, a real card).

tokens.name: card-max
tokens.usage: Largest account card width; at 390pt it fills the gutters.

tokens.name: stack-peek
tokens.usage: How much of each card behind shows above the front card in a CardStack.

tokens.name: tabbar-fade
tokens.usage: Height of the canvas fade under the floating tab bar; also the scroll bottom inset.

opacity.note: Material strengths for object faces and states.

tokens.name: opacity-grain
tokens.usage: Monochrome noise on object faces only (cards, the prominent button stays clean). Never on canvas or chrome.

tokens.name: opacity-specular
tokens.usage: Peak of the specular highlight that follows tilt on the five light object fields; graphite runs at a third of it (about 0.1) so on-graphite-2 keeps 4.5:1.

tokens.name: opacity-shift
tokens.usage: How far the monthly face shift moves an account card end stop toward its dominant spending category field.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.
